description: Evaluate a task's routing hints against the escalation policy and report whether it should be escalated, and to whom. Records a route_decision artefact.

default_escalation_target.description: Who to escalate to when the policy decides to escalate and names no target of its own. It must be a workspace member or a group URI; if the policy escalates with no usable target the call is refused with -32516.
